in_sanskrit.name: अनिकेता
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is not directed or controlled by another

in_hindi.name: अनिकेता
in_hindi.long_meaning: अज्ञानी को निर्देशित नहीं होती, वह स्वतंत्र है

in_tamil.name: அனிகேதா
in_tamil.long_meaning: Another's direction or control is not there

in_telugu.name: అనికేటా
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is free from control of others

in_marathi.name: Aniketa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Free from obstacles
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aniketa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ani- (free from) + keta (obstacles). This name signifies freedom from all hindrances and obstacles, leading to a path of spiritual growth.

in_bengali.name: Aniketa
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Free from obstacles
in_bengali.long_meaning: Aniketa একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Ani- (free from) + keta (obstacles). This name signifies freedom from all hindrances and obstacles, leading to a path of spiritual growth.
